content: Etsy shop suspended? Don't re-file the same appeal twice — it hurts your case. Free guide: how to triage temporary vs permanent, fix first, and write the 4-part letter reviewers actually read (with the 6-month deadline most sellers miss): https://galaxyaek7-del.github.io/openclaw-factory/customer_site/guide-etsy-suspension-appeal.html — method is free, no email needed. We also sell a $29 template kit; the guide stands alone.
